k_welcome.speaker: King
k_welcome.text: Welcome, traveler. The guards told me of your arrival. I trust you're enjoying your stay?

c_hail.speaker: Casimir
c_hail.text: Hail, great king. Unfortunately, I have not yet had the honor of enjoying your great kingdom. I've come bearing grave news from the Arcane University of Hollowmere!

k_proceed.speaker: King
k_proceed.text: Then let us not waste candlelight on pleasantries. Proceed with the message, traveler.

c_grim.speaker: Casimir
c_grim.text: The news from the Arcane University is grim, sire. Our mages found signs of an impending doom in the stars themselves. With a heavy heart I must inform you that the sun as we know it... is dying, my lord, and...

c_literal.speaker: Casimir
c_literal.text: In a literal sense, sire. The sun is dying. And that's not all...

c_frost.speaker: Casimir
c_frost.text: The University has concluded that, should the sun in fact die, a great frost will engulf the lands. A never-ending winter will come, sire.

k_forsaken.speaker: King
k_forsaken.action: The king silently turns away and walks toward the kingdom's crest. After a moment of silence, he speaks.
k_forsaken.text: Gods, how have we sinned? What have we done to deserve this punishment? The priest was right. We truly are forsaken.

k_graves.speaker: King
k_graves.text: So what now, then? Should we start digging our own graves? We would starve in any case. It's only a matter of time.

c_two_things.speaker: Casimir
c_two_things.text: You have two things right, sire, whether by chance or by your royal wisdom.

c_dig.speaker: Casimir
c_dig.text: The University and the Emperor have come to the conclusion that the best option for our survival is, in fact, to "dig".

c_future.speaker: Casimir
c_future.action: Casimir holds a moment of silence.
c_future.text: But we won't be digging our graves. We'll be digging a new future, a future underground. That is the only way we can survive.

k_insane.speaker: King
k_insane.text: That's insane! Have they lost their minds? What kind of alchemical concoction have they been drinking in that University?! How exactly are we supposed to build a whole kingdom underground?!

c_list.speaker: Casimir
c_list.text: The University has provided a list of what needs to be done, including the duties of the quartermaster, builders, diggers and miners. The Empire has provided quarry workers, and they should arrive in the coming weeks.

k_provides.speaker: King
k_provides.text: Seems the Emperor really does provide...

c_timeline.speaker: Casimir
c_timeline.text: Indeed, sire, and that's not all. The University has agreed on a timeline. All considered, the kingdom has about two years to finish digging and building before the frost engulfs the lands.

c_service.speaker: Casimir
c_service.text: An envoy such as myself has been sent to each kingdom under the Emperor's light, and we will lend our hands to help save humanity. I am at your full disposal, sire.

k_dying_date.speaker: King
k_dying_date.text: A dying date, for a dying kingdom. At least we have one last fighting chance. Wouldn't you agree, envoy?

c_peril.speaker: Casimir
c_peril.text: Indeed, sire. May the gods protect us in our time of peril.

k_rest.speaker: King
k_rest.text: We have made arrangements for you, envoy. You will be clothed, fed, washed and bedded. Go and rest. We will wait for the workers to come. Until then, I will make all the necessary arrangements.
